name: Adam Eaton
source: Adam and Sian grew up next door to each other on a small island in Hawaii. They've been close friends ever since a particularly awkward summer incident. He's laid back, relaxed, and generally likes to take things at his own pace. He spent most of his days writing bits of music as a way of avoiding doing homework. A producer recently discovered some of the songs he posted online and offered him a contract. His first single was a hit, and the sudden flood of attention is a bit overwhelming, but he's doing his best to take it in stride.
